'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Joseph Graham DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' EO Big Blue
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
